'''The Marina Group''' is a troupe of traveling entertainers that appeared in ''[[M09|Pokémon Ranger and the Temple of the Sea]]''. [[Shep]] helps plan the family's water shows, but does not perform in them. {{OBP|Kyle|M09}}, his wife [[Meredith]], and their daughter [[Lizabeth]] perform in the group's underwater Pokémon shows alongside their {{t|Water}} Pokémon.

The group are also direct descendants of the [[People of the Water]], and continue to be custodians of the ancient culture. This led {{OBP|Pokémon Ranger|Ranger series}} [[Jack Walker]] to temporarily join the troupe and perform as a clown while he tried to safely transport a {{OBP|Manaphy|M09}} {{pkmn|Egg}} back to [[Samiya]].
